limitations: This review covers layout, rendering and legibility only, for physical PDF pages 231-234. It makes no claim about mathematical correctness, source fidelity, cross-reference targets, theorem validity, adoption or delivery.

Glyph positions and alignment were judged by eye from the raster images. No pixel-level measurement, OCR or hash recomputation was performed. File hashes and PDF/source provenance (revision 44b25617befac48da660d59b90ec07d47ab118cc) were taken from source-manifest.json as metadata and not verified independently.
Pages before 231 and after 234 were not seen, so continuity across page breaks (the mid-sentence opening on P231, the ending on P234) was not checked against neighbouring pages.
This AI visual review is not human verification and cannot substitute for the required whole-paper mathematical reviewers or any Kimi HIGH gate.
